mission: MIM must prove it can produce context-first semantic interpretation objects before selecting a response mode.
why_this_exists: Current MIM behavior recognizes some broad conversation purposes but still relies on phrase gates, term lists, and reusable answer molds. This drill isolates interpretation from response generation.
forbidden: Do not add prompt wording to production phrase lists.
Do not add synonym lists as the repair.
Do not add exact route branches for any prompt in this drill.
Do not answer with an operational contract.

scoring.unknown_phrasing_minimum: semantic interpretation succeeds with no source edit or vocabulary expansion
scoring.fallback_minimum: when confidence is low, current interpretation appears before one focused question
